passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.1
passages.text: Sic ubi fata vocant, udis abiectus in herbis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.2
passages.text: Ad vada Maeandri concinit albus olor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.3
passages.text: Nec quia te nostra sperem prece posse moveri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.4
passages.text: Adloquor — adverso movimus ista deo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.5
passages.text: Sed merita et famam corpusque animumque pudicum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.6
passages.text: Cum male perdiderim, perdere verba leve est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.7
passages.text: Certus es ire tamen miseramque relinquere Dido,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.8
passages.text: Atque idem venti vela fidemque ferent?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.9
passages.text: Certus es, Aenea, cum foedere solvere naves,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.10
passages.text: Quaeque ubi sint nescis, Itala regna sequi?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.11
passages.text: Nec nova Carthago, nec te crescentia tangunt

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.12
passages.text: Moenia nec sceptro tradita summa tuo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.13
passages.text: Facta fugis, facienda petis; quaerenda per orbem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.14
passages.text: Altera, quaesita est altera terra tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.15
passages.text: Ut terram invenias, quis eam tibi tradet habendam?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.16
passages.text: Quis sua non notis arva tenenda dabit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.17
passages.text: Scilicet alter amor tibi restat et altera Dido;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.18
passages.text: Quamque iterum fallas altera danda fides.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.19
passages.text: Quando erit, ut condas instar Carthaginis urbem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.20
passages.text: Et videas populos altus ab arce tuos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.21
passages.text: Omnia ut eveniant, nec te tua vota morentur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.22
passages.text: Unde tibi, quae te sic amet, uxor erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.23
passages.text: Uror, ut inducto ceratae sulpure taedae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.24
passages.text: Ut pia fumosis addita tura focis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.25
passages.text: Aeneas oculis semper vigilantis inhaeret;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.26
passages.text: Aenean animo noxque quiesque refert.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.27
passages.text: Ille quidem male gratus et ad mea munera surdus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.28
passages.text: Et quo, si non sim stulta, carere velim;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.29
passages.text: Non tamen Aenean, quamvis male cogitat, odi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.30
passages.text: Sed queror infidum questaque peius amo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.31
passages.text: Parce, Venus, nurui, durumque amplectere fratrem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.32
passages.text: Frater Amor, castris militet ille tuis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.33
passages.text: Aut ego, quae coepi, (neque enim dedignor) amorem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.34
passages.text: Materiam curae praebeat ille meae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.35
passages.text: Fallor, et ista mihi falso iactatur imago;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.36
passages.text: Matris ab ingenio dissidet ille suae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.37
passages.text: Te lapis et montes innataque rupibus altis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.38
passages.text: Robora, te saevae progenuere ferae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.39
passages.text: Aut mare, quale vides agitari nunc quoque ventis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.40
passages.text: Qua tamen adversis fluctibus ire paras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.41
passages.text: Quo fugis? obstat hiemps. hiemis mihi gratia prosit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.42
passages.text: Adspice, ut eversas concitet Eurus aquas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.43
passages.text: Quod tibi malueram, sine me debere procellis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.44
passages.text: Iustior est animo ventus et unda tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.45
passages.text: Non ego sum tanti — quid non censeris inique? —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.46
passages.text: Ut pereas, dum me per freta longa fugis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.47
passages.text: Exerces pretiosa odia et constantia magno,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.48
passages.text: Si, dum me careas, est tibi vile mori.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.49
passages.text: Iam venti ponent, strataque aequaliter unda

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.50
passages.text: Caeruleis Triton per mare curret equis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.51
passages.text: Tu quoque cum ventis utinam mutabilis esses!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.52
passages.text: Et, nisi duritia robora vincis, eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.53
passages.text: Quid, quasi nescires, insana quid aequora possint,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.54
passages.text: Expertae totiens tam male credis aquae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.55
passages.text: Ut, pelago suadente viam, retinacula solvas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.56
passages.text: Multa tamen latus tristia pontus habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.57
passages.text: Nec violasse fidem temptantibus aequora prodest;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.58
passages.text: Perfidiae poenas exigit ille locus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.59
passages.text: Praecipue cum laesus amor, quia mater Amorum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.60
passages.text: Nuda Cytheriacis edita fertur aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.61
passages.text: Perdita ne perdam, timeo, noceamve nocenti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.62
passages.text: Neu bibat aequoreas naufragus hostis aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.63
passages.text: Vive, precor! sic te melius quam funere perdam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.64
passages.text: Tu potius leti causa ferere mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.65
passages.text: Finge, age, te rapido — nullum sit in omine pondus! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.66
passages.text: Turbine deprendi; quid tibi mentis erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.67
passages.text: Protinus occurrent falsae periuria linguae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.68
passages.text: Et Phrygia Dido fraude coacta mori;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.69
passages.text: Coniugis ante oculos deceptae stabit imago

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.70
passages.text: Tristis et effusis sanguinolenta comis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.71
passages.text: Quid tanti est ut tum 'merui! concedite!' dicas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.72
passages.text: Quaeque cadent, in te fulmina missa putes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.73
passages.text: Da breve saevitiae spatium pelagique tuaeque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.74
passages.text: Grande morae pretium tuta futura via est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.75
passages.text: Haec minus ut cures, puero parcatur Iulo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.76
passages.text: Te satis est titulum mortis habere meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.77
passages.text: Quid puer Ascanius, quid di meruere Penates?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.78
passages.text: Ignibus ereptos obruet unda deos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.79
passages.text: Sed neque fers tecum, nec, quae mihi, perfide, iactas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.80
passages.text: Presserunt umeros sacra paterque tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.81
passages.text: Omnia mentiris, neque enim tua fallere lingua

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.82
passages.text: Incipit a nobis, primaque plector ego.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.83
passages.text: Si quaeras, ubi sit formosi mater Iuli —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.84
passages.text: Occidit a duro sola relicta viro!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.85
passages.text: Haec mihi narraras — sat me monuere! merentem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.86
passages.text: Ure; minor culpa poena futura mea est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.87
passages.text: Nec mihi mens dubia est, quin te tua numina damnent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.88
passages.text: Per mare, per terras septima iactat hiemps.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.89
passages.text: Fluctibus eiectum tuta statione recepi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.90
passages.text: Vixque bene audito nomine regna dedi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.91
passages.text: His tamen officiis utinam contenta fuissem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.92
passages.text: Et mihi concubitus fama sepulta foret!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.93
passages.text: Illa dies nocuit, qua nos declive sub antrum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.94
passages.text: Caeruleus subitis conpulit imber aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.95
passages.text: Audieram vocem; nymphas ululasse putavi —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.96
passages.text: Eumenides fati signa dedere mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.97
passages.text: Exige, laese pudor, poenas! violate Sychaei

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.98
passages.text: Ad quas, me miseram, plena pudoris eo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.99
passages.text: Est mihi marmorea sacratus in aede Sychaeus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.100
passages.text: (Oppositae frondes velleraque alba tegunt).

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.101
passages.text: Hinc ego me sensi noto quater ore citari;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.102
passages.text: Ipse sono tenui dixit 'Elissa, veni!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.103
passages.text: Nulla mora est, venio, venio tibi debita coniunx;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.104
passages.text: Sum tamen admissi tarda pudore mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.105
passages.text: Da veniam culpae! decepit idoneus auctor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.106
passages.text: Invidiam noxae detrahit ille meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.107
passages.text: Diva parens seniorque pater, pia sarcina nati,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.108
passages.text: Spem mihi mansuri rite dedere viri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.109
passages.text: Si fuit errandum, causas habet error honestas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.110
passages.text: Adde fidem, nulla parte pigendus erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.111
passages.text: Durat in extremum vitaeque novissima nostrae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.112
passages.text: Prosequitur fati, qui fuit ante, tenor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.113
passages.text: Occidit internas coniunx mactatus ad aras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.114
passages.text: Et sceleris tanti praemia frater habet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.115
passages.text: Exul agor cineresque viri patriamque relinquo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.116
passages.text: Et feror in dubias hoste sequente vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.117
passages.text: Adplicor his oris fratrique elapsa fretoque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.118
passages.text: Quod tibi donavi, perfide, litus emo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.119
passages.text: Urbem constitui lateque patentia fixi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.120
passages.text: Moenia finitimis invidiosa locis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.121
passages.text: Bella tument; bellis peregrina et femina temptor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.122
passages.text: Vixque rudis portas urbis et arma paro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.123
passages.text: Mille procis placui, qui me coiere querentes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.124
passages.text: Nescio quem thalamis praeposuisse suis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.125
passages.text: Quid dubitas vinctam Gaetulo tradere Iarbae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.126
passages.text: Praebuerim sceleri bracchia nostra tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.127
passages.text: Est etiam frater, cuius manus inpia poscit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.128
passages.text: Respergi nostro, sparsa cruore viri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.129
passages.text: Pone deos et quae tangendo sacra profanas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.130
passages.text: Non bene caelestis inpia dextra colit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.131
passages.text: Si tu cultor eras elapsis igne futurus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.132
passages.text: Paenitet elapsos ignibus esse deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.133
passages.text: Forsitan et gravidam Dido, scelerate, relinquas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.134
passages.text: Parsque tui lateat corpore clausa meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.135
passages.text: Accedet fatis matris miserabilis infans,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.136
passages.text: Et nondum nato funeris auctor eris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.137
passages.text: Cumque parente sua frater morietur Iuli,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.138
passages.text: Poenaque conexos auferet una duos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.139
passages.text: 'Sed iubet ire deus.' vellem, vetuisset adire,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.140
passages.text: Punica nec Teucris pressa fuisset humus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.141
passages.text: Hoc duce nempe deo ventis agitaris iniquis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.142
passages.text: Et teris in rabido tempora longa freto?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.143
passages.text: Pergama vix tanto tibi erant repetenda labore,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.144
passages.text: Hectore si vivo quanta fuere forent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.145
passages.text: Non patrium Simoenta petis, sed Thybridis undas —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.146
passages.text: Nempe ut pervenias, quo cupis, hospes eris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.147
passages.text: Utque latet vitatque tuas abstrusa carinas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.148
passages.text: Vix tibi continget terra petita seni.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.149
passages.text: Hos potius populos in dotem, ambage remissa,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.150
passages.text: Accipe et advectas Pygmalionis opes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.151
passages.text: Ilion in Tyriam transfer felicius urbem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.152
passages.text: Resque loco regis sceptraque sacra tene!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.153
passages.text: Si tibi mens avida est belli, si quaerit Iulus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.154
passages.text: Unde suo partus Marte triumphus eat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.155
passages.text: Quem superet, nequid desit, praebebimus hostem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.156
passages.text: Hic pacis leges, hic locus arma capit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.157
passages.text: Tu modo, per matrem fraternaque tela, sagittas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.158
passages.text: Perque fugae comites, Dardana sacra, deos —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.159
passages.text: Sic superent, quoscumque tua de gente reportat

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.160
passages.text: Mars ferus, et damni sit modus ille tui,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.161
passages.text: Ascaniusque suos feliciter inpleat annos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.162
passages.text: Et senis Anchisae molliter ossa cubent! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.163
passages.text: Parce, precor, domui, quae se tibi tradit habendam!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.164
passages.text: Quod crimen dicis praeter amasse meum?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.165
passages.text: Non ego sum Pthias magnisque oriunda Mycenis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.166
passages.text: Nec steterunt in te virque paterque meus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.167
passages.text: Si pudet uxoris, non nupta, sed hospita dicar;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.168
passages.text: Dum tua sit, Dido quidlibet esse feret.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.169
passages.text: Nota mihi freta sunt Afrum plangentia litus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.170
passages.text: Temporibus certis dantque negantque viam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.171
passages.text: Cum dabit aura viam, praebebis carbasa ventis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.172
passages.text: Nunc levis eiectam continet alga ratem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.173
passages.text: Tempus ut observem, manda mihi; certius ibis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.174
passages.text: Nec te, si cupies, ipsa manere sinam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.175
passages.text: Et socii requiem poscunt, laniataque classis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.176
passages.text: Postulat exiguas semirefecta moras;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.177
passages.text: Pro meritis et siqua tibi debebimus ultra,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.178
passages.text: Pro spe coniugii tempora parva peto —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.179
passages.text: Dum freta mitescunt et amor, dum tempore et usu

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.180
passages.text: Fortiter edisco tristia posse pati.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.181
passages.text: Si minus, est animus nobis effundere vitam;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.182
passages.text: In me crudelis non potes esse diu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.183
passages.text: Adspicias utinam, quae sit scribentis imago!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.184
passages.text: Scribimus, et gremio Troicus ensis adest,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.185
passages.text: Perque genas lacrimae strictum labuntur in ensem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.186
passages.text: Qui iam pro lacrimis sanguine tinctus erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.187
passages.text: Quam bene conveniunt fato tua munera nostro!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.188
passages.text: Instruis inpensa nostra sepulcra brevi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.189
passages.text: Nec mea nunc primum feriuntur pectora telo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.190
passages.text: Ille locus saevi vulnus amoris habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.191
passages.text: Anna soror, soror Anna, meae male conscia culpae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.192
passages.text: Iam dabis in cineres ultima dona meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.193
passages.text: Nec consumpta rogis inscribar Elissa Sychaei,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.194
passages.text: Hoc tantum in tumuli marmore carmen erit:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.195
passages.text: Praebuit Aeneas et causam mortis et ensem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 7.196
passages.text: Ipsa sua Dido concidit usa manu.
